subject: Quick fit check + three windows to lock demo for GenCart
messages:
From: Avery Torres <avery@gencart.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:22:04 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — self-serve signup + demo?

Hi Jasmine,

I signed up for the trial earlier and have been poking around the console. We're exploring using Redwood for a productized recommendations API (retail personalization) — low-latency generation for product descriptions and reranking for relevance.

Quick context:
- Company: GenCart (marketplace for local retailers)
- Expected QPS: 30–50 req/s at peak, mostly short prompts (avg 120 tokens)
- Monthly inference budget target: ~$7–10k
- Timeline: pilot in July; production in Q4

Would love a short demo to understand latency profiles, dedicated options, and billing model. I'm in PDT.

Thanks,
Avery Torres
Head of Engineering, GenCart
avery@gencart.ai
[Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Torres <avery@gencart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:01:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — self-serve signup + demo?

Hi Avery — great to meet you and thanks for signing up.

Short list of quick qualifying questions so we can tailor the session:
1) Which inference path is highest priority? (generation for marketing copy / recommendation reranking / embeddings + semantic search)
2) Can you confirm request-size distribution (tokens per request) and percent of chat-like multi-turn flows vs single-shot?
3) Any constraints on data residency or VPC requirement during the pilot?
4) Do you expect private deployments (customer-managed infra) for PII reasons, or is hosted acceptable?
5) Who else on your team would join the pilot (SRE/infra / ML eng / product) — names and timezones?

Proposed three short windows (all PDT, 30-min):
- Wed Apr 21, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Apr 22, 16:00–16:30
- Fri Apr 23, 08:30–09:00

If none of those work, share two times that do and Ben (cc'd) will lock the calendar.

I'll attach a quick demo checklist after we confirm—keeps the kickoff efficient.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
[Calendly: https://calendly.com/jasmine-redwood/30min]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Torres <avery@gencart.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:33 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — calendar invite (proposed Wed 21 10:00 PDT)

Hi Avery — following up to lock the Wed 21 slot at 10:00 PDT. I attached a provisional calendar invite; please accept or propose a different time.

Provisional agenda (20 min + 10 Q&A):
- Quick intro & success metrics (5)
- Walkthrough: latency profiles, dedicated vs hosted (8)
- Ask: confirm data/traffic patterns and next steps (7)

If you'd prefer the later slot on Thu 22 or Fri 23, say the word and I'll update.

Att: [Attachment: Redwood-demo-21Apr.ics (text/calendar)]

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
[Direct: +1 510 555 0123]
From: Avery Torres <avery@gencart.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:47:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — calendar invite (proposed Wed 21 10:00 PDT)

Thanks — Wed 21 10:00 PDT works for me. Accepted invite.

Quick answers inline:
> 1) Which inference path is highest priority?
Primarily: generation for short product descriptions (~80–150 tokens) and a light reranker pass for top-10.

> 2) Can you confirm request-size distribution...
Avg: ~120 tokens. 95% single-shot, 5% multi-turn.

> 3) Any constraints on data residency...
Hosted is fine for the pilot; production may need EU region later.

> 4) Do you expect private deployments...
Not required for pilot.

> 5) Who else on your team would join the pilot...
I'll have Nora (ML engineer, PST) and Sam (SRE, CET) join the production planning calls; they won't attend the initial demo.

Attaching a small sample of daily traffic profile and a 48-hour request log (redacted).
[Attachment: gencart_48h_sample.csv (text/csv, 94KB)]

See you Wed,
Avery
